en.intro: Krishna has just described the still mind. Now Arjuna asks how to recognize such a person in daily life.
en.body: Arjuna says: O Kesava, what are the marks of one whose wisdom is steady and who is absorbed in stillness? How does a person of steady understanding speak, sit, and walk? Arjuna asks a practical question, how does a steady man speak, sit, and walk, and Krishna answers by saying he is satisfied in the true self, a state where no desire remains. Krishna names this person steady in wisdom, setting out to describe the marks of such a state.
